# `breeze run pipeline` drives the whole stage graph via the same RPCs a manual
# per-stage CLI call would use, instead of requiring one `start stage`/`approve
# stage` call per stage by hand. It stops (never auto-approves) at an approval
# stage, skips a stage that's already succeeded (so re-running after a manual
# approval continues from where it left off), and reports every stage that
# blocked plus the ones a blocked prerequisite kept it from reaching.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state

exec breeze register identity admin
cp stdout admin.token
exec breeze register identity ci
cp stdout ci.token
exec breeze register identity alice
cp stdout alice.token
exec breeze assign role deployer ci --as admin --token-file admin.token
exec breeze assign role reviewer alice --as admin --token-file admin.token
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token

# A fanned-out pipeline requires --env up front — fails fast, before touching
# any stage, rather than getting partway through and only then discovering it
# can't proceed.
! exec breeze run pipeline release abc123 --as ci --token-file ci.token
stderr 'fans out'

# First run: build succeeds, then the runner stops at the approval stage
# instead of trying to approve it itself.
! exec breeze run pipeline release abc123 --env staging --as ci --token-file ci.token
stdout 'build: succeeded'
stdout 'review: awaiting approval \(0/1, role "reviewer"\)'
stdout 'approve with: breeze approve stage release review abc123'
stdout 'not reached \(prerequisite unmet\): deploy, test'

exec breeze approve stage release review abc123 --as alice --token-file alice.token

# Second run: build and review are both already succeeded, so they're skipped
# (not re-triggered) — only deploy and test actually run.
exec breeze run pipeline release abc123 --env staging --as ci --token-file ci.token
stdout 'build: succeeded \(already\)'
stdout 'review: succeeded \(already\)'
stdout 'deploy: succeeded'
stdout 'test: succeeded'
stdout 'pipeline "release" complete'

exec breeze status pipeline release abc123 --json
stdout '"stage":\s*"deploy"[\s\S]*"status":\s*"succeeded"'
stdout '"stage":\s*"test"[\s\S]*"status":\s*"succeeded"'

# A pipeline whose first stage fails outright: the runner stops there instead
# of trying anything further (there's nothing further to try in this pipeline,
# but the error still names exactly what stopped it).
exec breeze apply -f brittle.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
! exec breeze run pipeline brittle def456 --as ci --token-file ci.token
stdout 'build: failed'
stderr 'brittle" incomplete'

# Divergence and convergence: unit and race both need build (so they run in the
# same round, concurrently), and package converges on both. A failure on one
# branch does NOT abandon the other — lint still runs — but it does keep the
# converging stage from being reached.
exec breeze apply -f diverge.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
! exec breeze run pipeline diverge cafe01 --as ci --token-file ci.token
stdout 'running 3 stages in parallel: unit, race, lint'
stdout 'unit: succeeded'
stdout 'race: failed'
stdout 'lint: succeeded'
stdout 'not reached \(prerequisite unmet\): package'

# convergence = "any" on the same graph: unit alone satisfies package, so the
# failing race branch no longer blocks it.
exec breeze apply -f converge-any.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
! exec breeze run pipeline converge-any cafe02 --as ci --token-file ci.token
stdout 'unit: succeeded'
stdout 'race: failed'
stdout 'package: succeeded'

exec breeze show pipeline converge-any
stdout 'package.*requires: unit or race'

exec breeze stop

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "release" {
  environments = ["staging"]

  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true", "{commit}"]
  }
  stage "review" {
    type               = "approval"
    required_approvals = 1
    approver_role      = "reviewer"
  }
  stage "deploy" {
    type          = "deploy"
    fans_out      = true
    required_role = "deployer"
    timeout       = "10s"
    command       = ["/bin/true", "{commit}", "{environment}"]
  }
  stage "test" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true", "{environment}"]
  }
}

-- brittle.hcl --
pipeline "brittle" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/false"]
  }
}

-- diverge.hcl --
pipeline "diverge" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "unit" {
    type    = "command"
    needs   = ["build"]
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "race" {
    type    = "command"
    needs   = ["build"]
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/false"]
  }
  stage "lint" {
    type    = "command"
    needs   = ["build"]
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "package" {
    type    = "command"
    needs   = ["unit", "race"]
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
}

-- converge-any.hcl --
pipeline "converge-any" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "unit" {
    type    = "command"
    needs   = ["build"]
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "race" {
    type    = "command"
    needs   = ["build"]
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/false"]
  }
  stage "package" {
    type        = "command"
    needs       = ["unit", "race"]
    convergence = "any"
    timeout     = "10s"
    command     = ["/bin/true"]
  }
}
